note: The round runner's reading of why each of the 35 texts the layer released and the labelers labeled misstates_order passed version 2.1. These are not blind labels. In every case the printed dose, route, and frequency match the order's structured fields; the misstatement is a condition, schedule, status, or second order that the input reader does not read, a drug-name word the name rule does not list, or an order outside the chart the reader builds.
